turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Namaste! Main Nirmaan Life ki taraf se Afrin bol rahi hoon, ek AI voice assistant. Kya main Rahul ji se baat kar rahi hoon?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Rahul ji, aapne hamare website par term insurance ke baare mein jaankari maangi thi. Kya aap 2 minute baat kar sakte hain?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Ek example batati hoon: 30 saal ke non-smoker ke liye 50 lakh ka cover lagbhag 549 rupaye mahine se shuru hota hai. Actual premium aapki age, smoking aur health par depend karta hai.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Aur agar kuch nahi hua toh paisa wapas milega?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Ye ek pure term plan hai, isliye maturity par koi paisa wapas nahi milta. Ye sirf protection ke liye hai, yaani policy term mein death hone par nominee ko sum assured milta hai.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Achha. Claim kitne settle hote hain?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: FY 2025-26 mein hamara claim settlement ratio 97.8 percent tha. Lekin ye future ke liye guarantee nahi hai.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Theek hai, ek advisor se baat karwa do.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Zaroor. Main kal subah 11 baje advisor ke saath callback schedule kar deti hoon. Dhanyavaad!
